metric_definitions.accuracy: Pooled fraction of successful predictions that are correct.
metric_definitions.balanced_accuracy: Mean recall of the classes present in the evaluated rows.
metric_definitions.f1_macro: Pooled macro F1 over labels 0 and 1, zero_division=0.
metric_definitions.roc_auc: Pooled AUC on successful rows with actual predicted probabilities; null if unavailable.
metric_definitions.coverage: Successful predictions divided by attempted predictions; always report with scores.
metric_definitions.mean_subject_accuracy: Unweighted mean of each held-out participant's accuracy.

limitations: Correct execution does not establish state-of-the-art performance.
Comparison requires identical dataset versions, trial identities, event phases, splits and metrics.
Scores from legacy tables cannot verify original trial alignment or supervised feature fitting.
